comment: Shared scenario definitions for validating the warrior sim against WarriorSim (https://github.com/GuybrushGit/WarriorSim). Item, buff and talent names map to both sims in run_warriorsim.mjs and reference_test.go.

scenarios.name: white-2h-tauren
scenarios.description: Auto attacks only, two-hander, 300 weapon skill, no gear, talents or buffs. Checks the attack table, glancing blows, crits and weapon damage.

scenarios.name: white-2h-orc-axe
scenarios.description: As white-2h-tauren but an orc with an axe, so 305 weapon skill from the racial.

scenarios.name: white-dw-tauren
scenarios.description: Auto attacks only, dual-wielding one-handers. Checks the dual-wield miss penalty and off-hand damage.

scenarios.name: fury-dw-p1
scenarios.description: Fury dual-wield with WoWSims' phase 1 gear (no enchants), Berserker Stance, no raid buffs. Bloodrage, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Heroic Strike at 30+ rage. Checks rage, abilities, procs and talents together.

scenarios.name: arms-2h-p1
scenarios.description: Arms two-hander (Arcanite Reaper, orc axe skill) with the same phase 1 armour, Berserker Stance, no raid buffs. Bloodrage, Mortal Strike, Whirlwind, Heroic Strike at 50+ rage.

scenarios.name: fury-dw-p1-buffed
scenarios.description: fury-dw-p1 as a Human (paladin blessings are Alliance-only), plus common raid buffs and consumables: Blessing of Kings, improved Blessing of Might, improved Mark of the Wild, Leader of the Pack, Elixir of the Mongoose, Juju Power, Juju Might, Smoked Desert Dumplings.
